text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A meta-analysis of randomized trials found intermittent energy restriction achieved weight loss comparable to continuous restriction, with a non-significant weighted mean difference of -0.61 kg.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A Harvard Nutrition Source summary of reviews found no significant difference in weight loss or body composition between fasting and continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#6"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A systematic review reported that twelve studies comparing intermittent fasting to calorie restriction found equivalent results.","cited_pids":["f781c705b786#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"One meta-analysis reported a small, statistically significant extra body weight reduction with intermittent fasting, though BMI did not differ.","cited_pids":["e5e8a6defcd9#1"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Dropout rates were not lower with intermittent fasting than with continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#6"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Small trials combining fasting with calorie restriction reported weight loss.","cited_pids":["23334c40ad6b#0"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Intermittent fasting is roughly comparable in weight-loss effect to daily calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#2"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Long-term trials of intermittent fasting for weight loss are still needed.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#2"]}]}
